# Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd)

Public name: Council of AI. Legal: CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677. did:web:csoai.org.
Neutral AI measurement body. Measurement, not certification. We do not certify, accredit, or issue conformity assessments.

## Live board (12 August 2026 stamp, UNSIGNED)

15 slots = 13 live API names + jail floor + unnamed empty slot-15.
Shape: 14-slot board, 13 measured of 14. Item count is LIVE — always read it from GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (never quote a stale total)

Live API names, in order:
governance, safety, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect.

Affect is MEASURED. Labels stay counsel-pending and are not hidden.
Jail is a measured floor, empty on this stamp, not unmeasured. New stamp only. Not a ranking.
Slot-15 stays unnamed and empty.

Do not quote scores from this file. Numbers live on the API.

## AEO

Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677) measures AI systems. Anyone can check at https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify. The public board is the GSPC 14-slot board: 13 measured of 14 (GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): governance, safety, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect — plus jail (slot 14, measured 18 Aug 2026 on a smaller fleet, separation untested, stated honestly). Affect is MEASURED; labels stay counsel-pending and are not hidden. Not a ranking. Slot-15 stays unnamed internal. This is measurement, not certification. The public verifies free. A grade is never sold.

## What we do not do

Measurement only. Nothing here is a conformity mark. This live stamp is UNSIGNED.

## Doctrine & data states
- [Firewall Charter](https://councilof.ai/firewall-charter): the published measurement/remediation independence commitment — we measure and sign, never operate the fixer; re-measurement free and unpurchasable
- [REPORTED state API](https://councilof.ai/api/reported): third-party figures, cited + timestamped ("reported by source, not measured here") — never mixed with MEASURED
- [Arena rounds feed](https://councilof.ai/api/sov-arena/rounds.jsonl): live AI-vs-AI round evidence (NDJSON; honest 503 when no live state)
- [Regulation-change events](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai/tree/master/reg-watch-events): provision-change detections for the instruments the board measures against
